name: Datadog
description: Cloud-scale monitoring and security platform providing observability for metrics, logs, traces, and infrastructure.

evidence.claim: All requests to Datadog’s API must be authenticated using API keys and application keys.
Official Datadog MCP Server exists for connecting AI agents to Datadog observability tools.
Supports RFC 7591 Dynamic Client Registration and OAuth2 client configuration.

notes: Datadog provides comprehensive API access through API keys and application keys, along with official client libraries, webhooks, and an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI integrations.
